description: Delegate a task to a subagent and return its final answer. list returns the profiles and models available to start, with when to use each. start needs task and either profile (a fresh subagent using a listed profile, optionally with a listed model) or fork=true (a subagent that inherits this conversation up to the current user message). continue sends a new task to an idle subagent by agent_id. inspect reports a subagent's working, settled (finished), and answer. With background=true, start and continue return the agent_id at once.

profile.description: Profile name from list for a fresh subagent; start only, excludes fork

model.description: Model name from list; defaults to this conversation's model; start with profile only

fork.description: Inherit this conversation; start only, excludes profile

background.description: Return without waiting for the answer; start or continue only

task.description: Instructions for the subagent; required for start and continue

agent_id.description: Subagent from an earlier start; required for inspect and continue
